summary.text: Robert Bierman is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 56A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican A.J. Prospect is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Robert Bierman lives in Apple Valley, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in history from the University of Minnesota.
His career experience includes working as a business owner at his family's flooring and home furnishing company, and he served as president of the local chamber of commerce.
Robert Bierman won re-election in 2020, 2022 and 2024, most recently defeating Republican Angela Zorn on November 5, 2024.
Bierman's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Health Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Chair), the Education Policy Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
